title: First answer wins
hints: Derive ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx) and defer cancel(). Cancelling tells every function still running to stop.
Start one goroutine per function, each sending its result on a channel with room for all of them, so nobody blocks after you return.
Receive len(fns) results. Return the first success straight away (the deferred cancel stops the rest). Collect the errors, and if every function failed, return errors.Join(errs...).
